diff --git a/app/scripts/operator-lifecycle-r40.ps1 b/app/scripts/operator-lifecycle-r40.ps1
index 5e40cb2..81195ae 100644
--- a/app/scripts/operator-lifecycle-r40.ps1
+++ b/app/scripts/operator-lifecycle-r40.ps1
@@ -1,60 +1,60 @@
-param(
-  [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
-  [ValidateSet("RUNNING_MANAGED","RUNNING_ATTACH","PAUSED_BROWSER","PAUSED_ALL")]
-  [string]$Mode = "PAUSED_BROWSER",
-
-  [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
-  [string]$BaseUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:17448",
-
-  [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
-  [switch]$DryRun
-)
-
-$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
-
-function Invoke-BridgeJson {
-  param(
-    [string]$Method,
-    [string]$Path,
-    [object]$Body = $null
-  )
-  $uri = ($BaseUrl.TrimEnd("/")) + $Path
-  if ($null -eq $Body) {
-    return Invoke-RestMethod -Method $Method -Uri $uri -TimeoutSec 10
-  }
-  $params = @{
-    Method = $Method
-    Uri = $uri
-    ContentType = "application/json"
-    Body = ($Body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress)
-    TimeoutSec = 20
-  }
-  return Invoke-RestMethod @params
-}
-
-$current = Invoke-BridgeJson -Method "GET" -Path "/api/operator-lifecycle"
-if ($DryRun) {
-  [pscustomobject]@{
-    contract = "bridge.operator_lifecycle.r40.v1"
-    dryRun = $true
-    requestedMode = $Mode
-    currentMode = $current.mode
-    currentRevision = $current.revision
-    mutationPerformed = $false
-    note = "Dry-run is read-only. No Chrome, worker, queue or Bridge process is changed."
-  } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
-  exit 0
-}
-
-$result = Invoke-BridgeJson -Method "POST" -Path "/api/operator-lifecycle" -Body @{
-  mode = $Mode
-  changedBy = "operator_script"
-  reason = "explicit R40 operator lifecycle command"
-}
-
-$result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12
-if ($Mode -eq "PAUSED_ALL" -and -not $result.quiesced) {
-  Write-Error "PAUSED_ALL was persisted but quiescence was not fully confirmed. Review lifecycle.quiescence.errors before any resume/cutover."
-  exit 3
-}
-exit 0
+param(
+  [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
+  [ValidateSet("RUNNING_MANAGED","RUNNING_ATTACH","PAUSED_BROWSER","PAUSED_ALL")]
+  [string]$Mode = "PAUSED_BROWSER",
+
+  [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
+  [string]$BaseUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:17448",
+
+  [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
+  [switch]$DryRun
+)
+
+$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
+
+function Invoke-BridgeJson {
+  param(
+    [string]$Method,
+    [string]$Path,
+    [object]$Body = $null
+  )
+  $uri = ($BaseUrl.TrimEnd("/")) + $Path
+  if ($null -eq $Body) {
+    return Invoke-RestMethod -Method $Method -Uri $uri -TimeoutSec 10
+  }
+  $params = @{
+    Method = $Method
+    Uri = $uri
+    ContentType = "application/json"
+    Body = ($Body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress)
+    TimeoutSec = 20
+  }
+  return Invoke-RestMethod @params
+}
+
+$current = Invoke-BridgeJson -Method "GET" -Path "/api/operator-lifecycle"
+if ($DryRun) {
+  [pscustomobject]@{
+    contract = "bridge.operator_lifecycle.r40.v1"
+    dryRun = $true
+    requestedMode = $Mode
+    currentMode = $current.mode
+    currentRevision = $current.revision
+    mutationPerformed = $false
+    note = "Dry-run is read-only. No Chrome, worker, queue or Bridge process is changed."
+  } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
+  exit 0
+}
+
+$result = Invoke-BridgeJson -Method "POST" -Path "/api/operator-lifecycle" -Body @{
+  mode = $Mode
+  changedBy = "operator_script"
+  reason = "explicit R40 operator lifecycle command"
+}
+
+$result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12
+if ($Mode -eq "PAUSED_ALL" -and -not $result.quiesced) {
+  Write-Error "PAUSED_ALL was persisted but quiescence was not fully confirmed. Review lifecycle.quiescence.errors before any resume/cutover."
+  exit 3
+}
+exit 0
